subject: CS360
filterSummary: Successfully selected 5 English and 3 Arabic videos. English coverage is excellent, with highly relevant and popular videos for all topics. Arabic coverage is weaker, with two topics (CSMA/CD & Hidden Station Problem) having no eligible videos due to candidates failing hard gates (duration, relevance, language). For the remaining Arabic topics, the best available options were chosen, though one is a general lecture with a relevant sub-section.
